  <div style="padding-top:0.5in;z-index:2;min-height:0.3in;position:relative;box-sizing:border-box;"><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:5pt;margin-top:0;font-family:'Tahoma',sans-serif;margin-bottom:0;text-align:center;margin-left:0;margin-right:0;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:5pt;font-family:'Tahoma',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p></div>
  <div class="main-content-container" style="z-index:5;position:relative;"><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:9pt;margin-top:9pt;font-family:'Tahoma',sans-serif;margin-bottom:18pt;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;text-decoration:underline solid;font-size:9pt;font-family:'Tahoma',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Operating EBITDA</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;text-decoration:underline solid;font-size:9pt;font-family:'Tahoma',sans-serif;font-style:italic;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">re</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;text-decoration:underline solid;font-size:9pt;font-family:'Tahoma',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">:</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:'Tahoma',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">  Nareit EBITDA</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:'Tahoma',sans-serif;font-style:italic;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">re</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:'Tahoma',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> is a measure of REIT performance, which the Nareit defines as net income, computed in accordance with GAAP, excluding (i) interest expense; (ii) income tax expense; (iii) depreciation and amortization; (iv) gains on sales of real estate; (v) impairments of real estate; and (vi) adjustments to reflect the Company&#x2019;s share of unconsolidated partnerships and joint ventures.  Operating EBITDA</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:'Tahoma',sans-serif;font-style:italic;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">re</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:'Tahoma',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> excludes from Nareit EBITDA</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:'Tahoma',sans-serif;font-style:italic;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">re</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:'Tahoma',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> certain non-cash components of earnings derived from straight-line rents and above and below market rent amortization.  The Company provides a reconciliation of Net Income to Nareit EBITDA</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:'Tahoma',sans-serif;font-style:italic;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">re</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:'Tahoma',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> to Operating EBITDA</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:'Tahoma',sans-serif;font-style:italic;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">re</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:'Tahoma',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">.</font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:9pt;margin-top:0;font-family:'Tahoma',sans-serif;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;text-decoration:underline solid;font-size:9pt;font-family:'Tahoma',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Pro-rata information:</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:'Tahoma',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> includes 100% of the Company&#x2019;s consolidated properties plus its economic share (based on the ownership interest) in the unconsolidated real estate investment partnerships. The Company provides Pro-rata financial information because Regency believes it assists investors and analysts in estimating the economic interest in the consolidated and unconsolidated real estate investment partnerships, when read in conjunction with the Company&#x2019;s reported results under GAAP.  The Company believes presenting its Pro-rata share of assets, liabilities, operating results, and other metrics, along with certain other non-GAAP financial measures, makes comparisons of its operating results to those of other REITs more meaningful.  The Pro-rata information provided is not, nor is it intended to be, presented in accordance with GAAP.  The Pro-rata supplemental details of assets and liabilities and supplemental details of operations reflect the Company&#x2019;s proportionate economic ownership of the assets, liabilities, and operating results of the properties in our portfolio.</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:'Tahoma',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">  </font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:9pt;margin-top:9pt;font-family:'Tahoma',sans-serif;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:'Tahoma',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">The Pro-rata information is prepared on a basis consistent with the comparable consolidated amounts and is intended to more accurately reflect the Company&#x2019;s proportionate economic interest in the assets, liabilities, and operating results of properties in its portfolio.  The Company does not control the unconsolidated real estate partnerships, and the Pro-rata presentations of the assets and liabilities, and revenues and expenses do not represent our legal claim to such items.  The partners are entitled to profit or loss allocations and distributions of cash flows according to the operating agreements, which generally provide for such allocations according to their invested capital.  The Company&#x2019;s share of invested capital establishes the ownership interests Regency uses to prepare its Pro-rata share.</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:'Tahoma',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">  </font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:9pt;margin-top:9pt;font-family:'Tahoma',sans-serif;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:'Tahoma',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">The presentation of Pro-rata information has limitations which include, but are not limited to, the following:</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:'Tahoma',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> </font></p><div class="item-list-element-wrapper" style="margin-left:4.528%;tab-size:32px;display:flex;font-size:9pt;margin-top:3pt;justify-content:flex-start;font-family:'Tahoma',sans-serif;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:4.537%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:4.7521786492374725%;word-break:keep-all;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">&#x2022;</font><div style="display:inline;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:'Tahoma',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">The amounts shown on the individual line items were derived by applying our overall economic ownership interest percentage determined when applying the equity method of accounting and do not necessarily represent our legal claim to the assets and liabilities, or the revenues and expenses; and </font></div></div><div class="item-list-element-wrapper" style="margin-left:4.528%;tab-size:32px;display:flex;font-size:9pt;margin-top:3pt;justify-content:flex-start;font-family:'Tahoma',sans-serif;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:4.537%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:4.7521786492374725%;word-break:keep-all;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">&#x2022;</font><div style="display:inline;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:'Tahoma',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Other companies in our industry may calculate their Pro-rata interest differently, limiting the comparability of Pro-rata information. </font></div></div><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:9pt;margin-top:9pt;font-family:'Tahoma',sans-serif;margin-bottom:18pt;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:'Tahoma',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Because of these limitations, the Pro-rata financial information should not be considered independently or as a substitute for the financial statements as reported under GAAP.  The Company compensates for these limitations by relying primarily on our GAAP financial statements, using the Pro-rata information as a supplement.</font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:9pt;margin-top:0;font-family:'Tahoma',sans-serif;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;text-decoration:underline solid;font-size:9pt;font-family:'Tahoma',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Same Property NOI:</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:'Tahoma',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> a key non-GAAP financial measure commonly used by real estate investment trusts (REITs) to evaluate operating performance. It is calculated on a Pro-rata ownership basis for properties owned and operated for the entirety of both the current and prior comparable reporting periods.</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:'Tahoma',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> </font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:9pt;margin-top:9pt;font-family:'Tahoma',sans-serif;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:'Tahoma',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Same Property NOI includes revenues and operating expenses associated with these properties but excludes items that are not indicative of ongoing operating performance. These include, without limitation, termination fees, as well as corporate-level expenses, financing costs, and other non-operating items.</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:'Tahoma',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> </font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:9pt;margin-top:9pt;font-family:'Tahoma',sans-serif;margin-bottom:18pt;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:'Tahoma',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Management believes this measure provides investors with a useful and consistent comparison of the Company&#x2019;s operating performance and trends.  Management uses Same Property NOI as a supplemental measure to assess property-level performance and to compare the performance of its stabilized property portfolio across reporting periods. This measure allows investors to evaluate trends in revenue and expense growth for properties that have been consistently operated during the periods.</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:'Tahoma',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> </font></p></div>
  <div style="z-index:2;flex-direction:column;display:flex;padding-bottom:0.5in;min-height:0.25in;justify-content:flex-end;position:relative;box-sizing:border-box;"><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:6pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:right;margin-left:0;margin-right:0;"><img src="img25796562_3.gif" alt="img25796562_3.gif" style="width:50px;height:27px;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">                            </font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8pt;font-family:Arial;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">  </font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">                                                                                                                                       </font><font style="color:#404040;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:6pt;font-family:Arial;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Supplemental Information</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8pt;font-family:Arial;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">  </font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">  </font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">29</font></p></div>
  <hr style="margin-inline-start:auto;margin-inline-end:auto;page-break-after:always;">
  <div style="padding-top:0.5in;z-index:2;min-height:0.3in;position:relative;box-sizing:border-box;"><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:5pt;margin-top:0;font-family:'Tahoma',sans-serif;margin-bottom:0;text-align:center;margin-left:0;margin-right:0;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:5pt;font-family:'Tahoma',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p></div>
  <div class="main-content-container" style="z-index:5;position:relative;"><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:9pt;margin-top:9pt;font-family:'Tahoma',sans-serif;margin-bottom:18pt;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:9pt;font-family:'Tahoma',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Other Defined Terms</font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:9pt;margin-top:0;font-family:'Tahoma',sans-serif;margin-bottom:18pt;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;text-decoration:underline solid;font-size:9pt;font-family:'Tahoma',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Anchor Space:</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:'Tahoma',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> A space equal to or greater than 10,000 SF.</font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:9pt;margin-top:0;font-family:'Tahoma',sans-serif;margin-bottom:18pt;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;text-decoration:underline solid;font-size:9pt;font-family:'Tahoma',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Development Completion</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:9pt;font-family:'Tahoma',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">:</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:'Tahoma',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">  A Property in Development that is deemed complete upon the earlier of (i) 90% of total estimated net development costs have been incurred and percent leased equals or exceeds 95%, or (ii) the property features at least two years of anchor operations. Once deemed complete, the property is termed a Retail Operating Property.</font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:9pt;margin-top:0;font-family:'Tahoma',sans-serif;margin-bottom:18pt;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;text-decoration:underline solid;font-size:9pt;font-family:'Tahoma',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Expense Recovery Ratio:</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:'Tahoma',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> Represents the percentage of real estate operating expenses, excluding ground rent, that is reimbursed by tenants. Expense Recovery Ratio is calculated as recoveries from tenants divided by total real estate operating expenses, excluding ground rent.</font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:9pt;margin-top:0;font-family:'Tahoma',sans-serif;margin-bottom:18pt;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;text-decoration:underline solid;font-size:9pt;font-family:'Tahoma',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">NOI Margin:</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:'Tahoma',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> The ratio of Same Property NOI to total real estate revenues.</font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:9pt;margin-top:0;font-family:'Tahoma',sans-serif;margin-bottom:18pt;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;text-decoration:underline solid;font-size:9pt;font-family:'Tahoma',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Non-Same Property:</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:'Tahoma',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">  Any property, during either calendar year period being compared, that was acquired, sold, a Property in Development, a Development Completion, or a property under, or being positioned for, significant redevelopment that distorts comparability between periods.  Non-retail properties and corporate activities, including the captive insurance program, are part of Non-Same Property.  Please refer to the footnote on Property Summary Report for Non-Same Property detail.</font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:9pt;margin-top:0;font-family:'Tahoma',sans-serif;margin-bottom:18pt;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;text-decoration:underline solid;font-size:9pt;font-family:'Tahoma',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Other lease income:</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:'Tahoma',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">  includes revenue derived from various lease-related activities beyond standard base or percentage rent. This primarily includes income from temporary tenants, late fees, signage and marketing fees, sustainability income, land/building rentals, communications tower leases, tenant/employee parking fees, incidental income, and other ancillary charges generally outlined in lease agreements.</font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:9pt;margin-top:0;font-family:'Tahoma',sans-serif;margin-bottom:18pt;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;text-decoration:underline solid;font-size:9pt;font-family:'Tahoma',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Other property income:</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:'Tahoma',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">  includes parking fees and other incidental income from the properties and is generally recognized at the point in time that the performance obligation is met.</font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:9pt;margin-top:0;font-family:'Tahoma',sans-serif;margin-bottom:18pt;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;text-decoration:underline solid;font-size:9pt;font-family:'Tahoma',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Property In Development:</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:'Tahoma',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">  Properties in various stages of ground-up development.</font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:9pt;margin-top:0;font-family:'Tahoma',sans-serif;margin-bottom:18pt;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;text-decoration:underline solid;font-size:9pt;font-family:'Tahoma',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Property In Redevelopment:</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:'Tahoma',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">  Retail Operating Properties under redevelopment or being positioned for redevelopment.  Unless otherwise indicated, a Property in Redevelopment is included in the Same Property pool.</font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:9pt;margin-top:0;font-family:'Tahoma',sans-serif;margin-bottom:18pt;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;text-decoration:underline solid;font-size:9pt;font-family:'Tahoma',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Redevelopment Completion:</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:'Tahoma',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">   A Property in Redevelopment that is deemed complete upon the earlier of (i) 90% of total estimated project costs have been incurred and percent leased equals or exceeds 95% for the Company owned GLA related to the project, or (ii) the property features at least two years of anchor operations, if applicable.</font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:9pt;margin-top:0;font-family:'Tahoma',sans-serif;margin-bottom:18pt;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;text-decoration:underline solid;font-size:9pt;font-family:'Tahoma',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Retail Operating Property:</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:'Tahoma',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">  Any retail property not termed a Property In Development. A retail property is any property where the majority of the income is generated from retail uses.</font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:9pt;margin-top:0;font-family:'Tahoma',sans-serif;margin-bottom:18pt;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;text-decoration:underline solid;font-size:9pt;font-family:'Tahoma',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Same Property:</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:'Tahoma',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">   Retail Operating Property that was owned and operated for the entirety of both calendar year periods being compared. This term excludes Property in Development, prior year Development Completions, and Non-Same Properties. Property in Redevelopment is included unless otherwise indicated.</font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:9pt;margin-top:0;font-family:'Tahoma',sans-serif;margin-bottom:18pt;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;text-decoration:underline solid;font-size:9pt;font-family:'Tahoma',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Shop Space:</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:'Tahoma',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">  A space under 10,000 SF.</font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:6.5pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Arial;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:6.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p></div>
  <div style="z-index:2;flex-direction:column;display:flex;padding-bottom:0.5in;min-height:0.25in;justify-content:flex-end;position:relative;box-sizing:border-box;"><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:6pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:right;margin-left:0;margin-right:0;"><img src="img25796562_3.gif" alt="img25796562_3.gif" style="width:50px;height:27px;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">                            </font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8pt;font-family:Arial;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">  </font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">                                                                                                                                       </font><font style="color:#404040;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:6pt;font-family:Arial;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Supplemental Information</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8pt;font-family:Arial;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">  </font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">  </font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">30</font></p></div>
